decision_question: Should a regional retailer run an AI-assisted customer-service pilot?
executive_decision: Run a 30-day assistive customer-service pilot with human approval gates.

findings.claim: The synthetic support operation handles 4200 contacts per month.
Repetitive intents represent 61% of contacts, creating a bounded assistive use case.
First response currently takes 11.8 hours, above the eight-hour pilot threshold.

options.claim: Keep the current manual workflow and continue measuring the baseline.
Run a narrow assistive pilot for repetitive intents; recommended.
Fully automate replies; rejected because current evidence does not support that risk.

recommendations.claim: Run a 30-day assistive customer-service pilot with human approval gates.
Keep sensitive-data filtering and human approval as release gates.

risks.claim: Customer messages may contain sensitive data, so raw text must not enter an uncontrolled model path.

assumptions: Synthetic records are directionally representative of the demonstration scenario.
The pilot will not send customer replies without an authorized reviewer.

pilot_plan.action: Confirm baseline definitions, approved intents and privacy gate.
Run shadow-mode suggestions against synthetic or approved test cases.
Review exceptions, false routing and reviewer overrides.
Compare against the baseline and make a human go/no-go decision.

success_measures: Median first-response time for the scoped intents
constraints: No paid API dependency in the public prototype
No raw payment or password data in an uncontrolled model path

evidence_register.title: Synthetic monthly support register
evidence_register.claim: The demonstration operation receives 4,200 support contacts per month.

evidence_register.title: Synthetic intent review
evidence_register.claim: The three most repetitive intents represent 61 percent of contacts.

evidence_register.title: Synthetic service baseline
evidence_register.claim: Median first response is 11.8 hours for the scoped channels.

evidence_register.title: Synthetic privacy review
evidence_register.claim: Customer messages can contain payment-card fragments, email addresses and passwords.

evidence_register.title: Unverified vendor marketing claim
evidence_register.claim: A vendor claims a 40 percent cost reduction without a reproducible method.
